page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.mn4.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine running on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY core operating at 2.5 GHz, utilizing hyper-threading to deliver 2 threads per core. The CPU allocation is shared. The instance features 8.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB per core, with no local storage or bundled GPUs.

Benchmark evaluations indicate modest performance across compute and memory subsystems. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance score is 1090.78, while the multi-core score is 2067.18. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 158.75 GB/sec, which drops to 16.93 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, and a write speed of 13.99 GB/sec. Geekbench scores reflect similar trends, with a single-core score of 939.0 and a multi-core score of 1598.0.

Given its shared CPU allocation, lack of local storage, and entry-level performance metrics, this instance is positioned as a budget-friendly option for low-intensity workloads. It is suitable for basic web serving, lightweight background tasks, or development and testing environments. It is not designed for memory-intensive databases, heavy multi-threaded processing, or high-throughput network applications.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.mn4.large is an x86_64 general-purpose virtual machine powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 vCPUs from a shared Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz, paired with 8.0 GB of RAM. The instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPUs. Performance benchmarks place this server in the lower tier, with a Geekbench single-core score of 939.0 and a multi-core score of 1598.0. Memory bandwidth is limited, reaching 16.93 GB/sec for large uncached reads. Given its shared CPU allocation and modest resource profile, the ecs.mn4.large is best suited for low-demand workloads such as lightweight web serving, basic development environments, and simple background tasks where cost efficiency is prioritized over high performance.
